paper.title_en: Quasinormal modes as probes of black hole reentrant phase transitions
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the interplay between thermodynamic phase transitions and the dynamical behavior of quasi-normal modes (QNMs) in weakly nonlinear charged anti-de Sitter black holes. In a non-extended phase space, we identify a reentrant large-small-large(intermediate) phase transition for these black holes. Employing the shooting method to solve the Klein-Gordon equation for a massless scalar field, we compute QNM frequencies across these phases, revealing distinct behaviors in different phases. Specifically, to our knowledge, this is the first report of utilizing QNMs as dynamical probes of thermodynamic phases during reentrant phase transitions including zeroth and first-order transitions. These findings establish QNMs as a powerful dynamical probe for thermodynamic phase transitions, providing new insights into the thermodynamic and dynamical properties of nonlinear charged black holes as well.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究弱非线性带电反德西特黑洞中热力学相变与准正规模（QNM）动力学行为之间的关联：在非扩展相空间中识别出重现式大-小-大（中间）相变，并用打靶法求解无质量标量场的克莱因-戈尔登方程，计算各相中的QNM频率。作者声称首次将QNM作为重现式相变（含零阶与一阶相变）热力学相的动力学探针，选题与黑洞热力学索引高度契合，理论深度与方法信号较强，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 准正规模作为黑洞重现式相变探针
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了弱非线性带电反德西特黑洞中热力学相变与准正规模（QNM）动力学行为之间的相互作用。在非扩展相空间中，我们识别出这些黑洞的一种重现式大-小-大（中间）相变。我们采用打靶法求解无质量标量场的克莱因-戈尔登方程，计算了这些相中的QNM频率，揭示了不同相中的不同行为。具体而言，据我们所知，这是首次报道利用QNM作为重现式相变（包括零阶和一阶相变）期间热力学相的动力学探针。这些发现确立QNM作为热力学相变的强大动力学探针，同时也为非线性带电黑洞的热力学和动力学性质提供了新的见解。
